clarity.notes: Review has one obvious action and exposes the blocking contradiction. Claims loses clarity because the full production chain is compressed.

hierarchy.notes: Verdict, blocker, action, and answer path read in order. Prototype state controls remain too visually prominent.

typography.notes: Sans and mono roles are disciplined and the headline breathes. Some graph labels are too small and collide.

motion.notes: Selection feedback exists, but graph re-layout and mobile navigation need refinement.

brand.notes: The evidence-dossier direction is coherent, but the cramped graph and exposed demo controls weaken the precision-instrument character.

changes_required: Give the graph a wider primary work area and reduce side-column widths.
Preserve readable graph labels on mobile through horizontal pan.
Move prototype state examples behind a disclosure.
Use a fixed mobile mode bar with reserved content space.
